50002.meaning1: perceiving as broken; regarding (something) as cracked

50003.meaning1: perceiving as broken; regarding (something) as cracked

examples.text: avinaṭṭhe vinaṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. abhinne bhinnasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avilutte viluttasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

50006.meaning1: creating harmony among the divided; unifying those split apart

examples.text: avivādavaḍḍhanakariṃ sugiraṃ, bhinn'ānusandhijananiṃ abhaṇi, kalahaṃ janassa panudī samaṅgī, sahitehi nandati pamodati ca.

50008.grammar: pp of bhijjati, nt nom sg of bhinna

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti, evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaṃyojane se bhinne.

50009.meaning1: more (than); greater than (than); better than (than); superior (to)
50009.meaning2: exceedingly, more, in a higher degree, repeatedly

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, ye kho keci atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayiṃsu, etāvaparamaṃ, na'y'ito bhiyyo.
yo ca sītañ'ca uṇhañ'ca, tiṇā bhiyyo na maññati, karaṃ purisakiccāni, so sukhā na vihāyati.

50010.meaning1: desire for more; greed for more; wanting more

examples.text: na sūpaṃ vā byañjanaṃ vā odanena paṭicchādessāmi bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāyā'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū sūpam'pi byañjanam'pi odanena paṭicchādenti bhiyyokamyataṃ upādāya
tattha appasannā c'eva pasīdanti, pasannānañ'ca bhiyyobhāvo hoti.
aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. katame aṭṭha?

50012.commentary: (DNa) bhiyyo'bhiññataro'ti bhiyyataro abhiññāto, bhiyyatar'ābhiñño vā, uttaritarañāṇo'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ, bhante, bhagavati, na c'āhu na ca bhavissati na c'eta'r'ahi vijjati añño samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā bhagavatā bhiyyo'bhiññataro yadidaṃ sambodhiyan'ti.

50013.meaning1: names of Koṇāgamana Buddha's pair of chief disciples; Bhiyyosa and Uttara
50013.meaning2: names of Koṇāgamana Buddha's pair of chief disciples; Bhiyyosa and Uttara
50013.commentary: (DNa) bhiyyosuttaran'ti bhiyyoso ca uttaro ca. tesu bhiyyoso paññāya uttaro, uttaro samādhinā aggo ahosi.

examples.text: koṇāgamanassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhiyyos'uttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.

50014.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of bhiyyo (+abl)
50014.meaning1: still more; even more; even greater (than); exceeding
50014.meaning2: exceedingly, more, in a higher degree, repeatedly
50014.construction:
√bhū > bhī + ya + o + so
bhiyyo + so

examples.text: evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso bhiyyosomattāya tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.
janapadakalyāṇī naccati gāyatī'ti kho, bhikkhave, bhiyyosomattāya mahājanakāyo sannipateyya.
sādhu, bhante, bhagavā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ samādisatu, yo uttarimanussadhammā, iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, ev'āyaṃ nāḷandā bhiyyoso mattāya bhagavati abhippasīdissatī'ti.

50016.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of bhiyyosomattā

examples.text: sādhu sādhu, āvuso yamaka! tena h'āvuso, yamaka, upamaṃ te karissāmi etass'eva atthassa bhiyyosomattāya ñāṇāya.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso bhiyyosomattāya tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.
so bajjhataṃ pāsasatehi chabbhi, rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ, tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.
bhisamuḷālaṃ gaṇhitvā, agamaṃ buddhasantikaṃ, tañ'ca buddhassa pādāsiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.
seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
aham'asmi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto.
yo rāgam'udacchidā asesaṃ, bhisapupphaṃ'va saroruhaṃ vigayha, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, araññ'āyatane mahāsarasī. taṃ nāgā upanissāya viharanti. te taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā akaddamaṃ saṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
bhisamuḷālaṃ gaṇhitvā, agamaṃ buddhasantikaṃ, tañ'ca buddhassa pādāsiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.

50022.commentary: (VIN 2.5.2.4) bhisi nāma pañca bhisiyo, uṇṇabhisi, coḷabhisi, vākabhisi, tiṇabhisi, paṇṇabhisi.
50022.notes: (MW) the seat of a religious student or of an ascetic

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghikaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhisiṃ vā kocchaṃ vā ajjhokāse santharitvā vā santharāpetvā vā taṃ pakkamanto n'eva uddhareyya, na uddharāpeyya, anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.

50023.commentary: (VINa) bhisicchavī'ti mañcabhisiyā vā pīṭhabhisiyā vā chavi, sace pūritā hoti vidhunitvā'pi gahetuṃ vaṭṭati.

examples.text: tass'āyasmato vihāro abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko, majjhegabbho, samantāpariyāgāro, supaññattaṃ mañcapīṭhaṃ bhisibimbohanaṃ, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ supaṭṭhitaṃ, pariveṇaṃ susammaṭṭhaṃ.

50027.meaning1: with a terrifying body; with awesome physical form
50027.commentary: (DNa) bhismākāyo'ti mahākāyo, dvīhi tīhi māgadhikehi gāmakkhettehi samappamāṇa-attabhāvo.

examples.text: sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ, mahābrahm'ābhitiṭṭhati, upapanno jutimanto, bhismākāyo yasassiso.
vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ, kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ, asahāyikā gantum'icchasi, rahitaṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ.

yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yā tā rattiyo abhiññātā abhilakkhitā, cātuddasī pañcadasī aṭṭhamī ca pakkhassa, tathārūpāsu rattīsu yāni tāni ārāmacetiyāni vanacetiyāni rukkhacetiyāni bhiṃsanakāni salomahaṃsāni tathārūpesu sen'āsanesu vihareyyaṃ app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhayabheravaṃ passeyyan'ti.

50030.construction:
bhiṃsa + ana + ka + tta > ta
bhiṃsanaka + tta > ta
50030.commentary: (MNa) bhiṃsanakatasmin'ti bhiṃsanakabhāve'ti attho. ekassa takārassa lopo daṭṭhabbo. bhiṃsanakattasmin'ti'y'eva vā pāṭho, bhiṃsanakatāya iti vā vattabbe liṅgavipallāso kato, nimitt'atthe c'etaṃ bhummavacanaṃ.

examples.text: atrāssudaṃ, sāriputta, bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti, yo koci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati, yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsanti.

50034.grammar: prp of caus pass of √bhis, caus, pass, trans (+acc)
50034.meaning1: being frightened; being terrified; being scared

50035.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.5) bhiṃsāpeyyā'ti upasampanno upasampannaṃ bhiṃsāpetu'kāmo rūpaṃ vā saddaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā rasaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbaṃ vā upasaṃharati.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ bhiṃsāpeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

50036.meaning1: wanting to frighten; wishing to scare

examples.text: bhiṃsāpeyyā'ti upasampanno upasampannaṃ bhiṃsāpetu'kāmo rūpaṃ vā saddaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā rasaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbaṃ vā upasaṃharati. bhāyeyya vā so na vā bhāyeyya, āpatti pācittiyassa.

50037.meaning1: to frighten; to terrify; to scare

examples.text: bhiṃsāpeyyā'ti upasampanno upasampannaṃ bhiṃsāpetu'kāmo rūpaṃ vā saddaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā rasaṃ vā phoṭṭhabbaṃ vā upasaṃharati. bhāyeyya vā so na vā bhāyeyya, āpatti pācittiyassa.
apuññalābho ca gatī ca pāpikā, bhītassa bhītāya ratī ca thokikā, rājā ca daṇḍaṃ garukaṃ paṇeti, tasmā naro paradāraṃ na seve.
yass'eva bhīto na dadāti maccharī, tadev'ādadato bhayaṃ, jighacchā ca pipāsā ca, yassa bhāyati maccharī, tam'eva bālaṃ phusati, asmiṃ loke paramhi ca.

50040.meaning1: state of fear; state of terror

examples.text: tassa te n'atthi bhītattaṃ, bhiyyo vaṇṇo pasīdati, kasmā na paridevesi, evarūpe mahabbhaye.

50043.commentary: (THIa) upasaggo bhīmarūpo'ti atibhiṃsanakasabhāvo, mahanto devat'ūpasaggo viya anatthak'ādidukkh'āvahanato.

examples.text: upasaggo bhīmarūpo, kāmā sappasir'ūpamā, ye bālā abhinandanti, andhabhūtā puthujjanā.

50045.meaning1: more (than); greater than (than); better than (than); superior (to)

examples.text: idha tappati pecca tappati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha tappati, pāpaṃ me katan'ti tappati, bhīyo tappati duggatiṃ gato.
yo pāṇabhūtāni aheṭhayaṃ caraṃ, par'ūpavādā na karonti pāpaṃ, bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na hi tattha sūraṃ, bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpan'ti.
puna caparaṃ, brāhmaṇa, idh'ekacco akatakalyāṇo hoti akatakusalo akatabhīruttāṇo katapāpo kataluddo katakibbiso. tam'enaṃ aññataro gāḷho rog'ātaṅko phusati.
yāvatā akatakalyāṇānaṃ akatakusalānaṃ akatabhīruttāṇānaṃ katapāpānaṃ kataluddānaṃ katakibbisānaṃ gati taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmī'ti.

50049.commentary: (MNa) bhīrukajātikā'ti bhīrukapakatikā, gāmadārakā viya bhayabahulā asūrā kātarā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā chambhī bhīrukajātikā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, chambhibhīrukajātikasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

50052.commentary: (MNa) bhīrukajātikā'ti bhīrukapakatikā, gāmadārakā viya bhayabahulā asūrā kātarā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā chambhī bhīrukajātikā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, chambhibhīrukajātikasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

50053.meaning1: protection against fear; refuge from fear; (comm) being a protector of the afraid

examples.text: tassa aññatarena gāḷhena rog'ātaṅkena phuṭṭhassa evaṃ hoti, akataṃ vata me kalyāṇaṃ, akataṃ kusalaṃ, akataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ, kataṃ pāpaṃ, kataṃ luddaṃ, kataṃ kibbisaṃ.
yāvatā akatakalyāṇānaṃ akatakusalānaṃ akatabhīruttāṇānaṃ katapāpānaṃ kataluddānaṃ katakibbisānaṃ gati taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmī'ti.

50054.meaning1: protection against fear; refuge from terror
50054.commentary: (ANa) bhītassa parittāyakattā bhīruttāṇan'ti vuccati. (ITIa) dukkhabhīrūnaṃ saṃsārabhīrūnañ'ca rakkhan'aṭṭhena bhīruttāṇan'ti ca vuccati.

examples.text: devapuragatānañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, devānaṃ etadahosi, bhīruttānagatena kho dāni mayaṃ eta'r'ahi attanā viharāma akaraṇīyā asurehī'ti. asurānam'pi, bhikkhave, etadahosi, bhīruttānagatena kho dāni devā eta'r'ahi attanā viharanti akaraṇīyā amhehī'ti.
nārī imā samparibhinnagattā, paggayha kandanti bhuje dujaccā, sammakkhitā lohitapubbalittā, gāvo yathā āghātane vikantā, tā bhūmibhāgasmiṃ sadā nikhātā, khandh'ātivattanti sajotibhūtā.

50068.commentary: (NIDD2) saṅghaṭṭayantāni duve bhujasmin'ti bhujo vuccati hattho. yathā ekasmiṃ hatthe dve nūpurāni ghaṭṭenti, evam'eva sattā taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena niraye ghaṭṭenti, tiracchānayoniyaṃ ghaṭṭenti, pettivisaye ghaṭṭenti, manussaloke ghaṭṭenti, devaloke ghaṭṭenti, gatiyā gatiṃ upapattiyā upapattiṃ paṭisandhiyā paṭisandhiṃ bhavena bhavaṃ saṃsārena saṃsāraṃ vaṭṭena vaṭṭaṃ ghaṭṭenti saṅghaṭṭenti saṅghaṭṭentā caranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpentī'ti, saṅghaṭṭayantāni duve bhujasmiṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. (BVa) bhujāni pothentī'ti bhuje apphoṭenti. liṅgavipariyāso daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: seḷenti gāyanti ca vādayanti ca, bhujāni phoṭenti ca naccayanti ca, pucchāmi vo'haṃ merumuddhavāsine, dhunātha me saṃsayaṃ khippa mārisā.
disvā suvaṇṇassa pabhassarāni, kammāraputtena suniṭṭhitāni, saṅghaṭṭamānāni duve bhujasmiṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

50069.commentary: (APt) bhuja pālanajjhohāresu. bāhu ca bhujo ce'ti dvando, ete dve dvīsu, itthiyaṃ bhujā.

examples.text: tato have dhitimā rājaputto, vanditvā mātu ca pitu ca pāde, dukhini'ssa mātā nipatā pathabyā, pit'āssa paggayha bhujāni kandati.

saṃsappanto gacchatī'ti sappo, bhujanto gacchatī'ti bhujago, urena gacchatī'ti urago, pannasiro gacchatī'ti pannago, sirena supatī'ti sarīsapo, bile sayatī'ti bilāsayo, guhāyaṃ sayatī'ti guh'āsayāo, dāṭhā tassa āvudho'ti dāṭh'āvudho, visaṃ tassa ghoran'ti ghoraviso, jivhā tassa duvidhā'ti dvijivho, dvīhi jivhāhi rasaṃ sāyatīti dvirasaññū.

50072.meaning1: name of a female deity; attendant of king Vessavaṇa
50072.meaning2: name of a female deity; king Vessavaṇa's daughter

examples.text: tena kho pana, bhante, samayena bhagavā aññatarena samādhinā nisinno hoti, bhujagī ca nāma vessavaṇassa mahārājassa paricārikā bhagavantaṃ paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, pañjalikā namassamānā tiṭṭhati.

50074.commentary: (APt) bhuja koṭilye, kuṭilāyamāno gacchatī'ti bhujaṅ'go, evaṃ bhujago, bhujaṅ'gamo ca.
50074.notes: Alternatively, bhū + jaṅgama, moving on the earth.

examples.text: gāme vā yadi v'āraññe, yattha passe bhujaṅ'gamaṃ. daharo'ti n'āvajāneyya, na naṃ paribhave naro.
tasmā hi paṇḍito poso, sampassaṃ attham'attano, bhujaṅ'gamaṃ pāvakañ'ca, khattiyañ'ca yasassinaṃ, bhikkhuñ'ca sīlasampannaṃ, samma'd'eva samācare'ti.

50075.meaning2: kind of pearl from a snake's head

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, mahānāma, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso dāso assa anatt'ādhīno par'ādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo. so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya att'ādhīno apar'ādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṃgamo.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, āṇaṇyaṃ yathā ārogyaṃ yathā bandhanāmokkhaṃ yathā bhujissaṃ yathā khem'antabhūmiṃ

50079.meaning1: state of being a free man

examples.text: etha, tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi bhuñjamānā app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānissatha app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'cā'ti.
ahaṃ kho, samaṇa, kasāmi ca vapāmi ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjāmi. tvam'pi, samaṇa, kasassu ca vapassu ca. kasitvā ca vapitvā ca bhuñjassū'ti.

50084.meaning1: (of sensual objects) uses; enjoys; partakes (of); indulges (in)
50084.commentary: (THa) kiṃ pana tan'ti āha bhuñja mānusake kāme'ti kāme paribhuñjitu'kāmassa rūpasampatti, vayasampatti, parivārasampatti, bhogasampatti ca icchitabbā.

examples.text: yuvā'si tvaṃ pabbajito, tiṭṭhāhi mama sāsane, bhuñja mānusake kāme, ahaṃ vittaṃ dadāmi te, saccaṃ te paṭijānāmi, aggiṃ vā te harām'ahaṃ.

tam'enaṃ jano disvā evaṃ vadeyya, bhogī vata, bho, puriso, evaṃ kira bhogino bhogāni bhuñjantī'ti. tam'enaṃ sāmikā yattha yatth'eva passeyyuṃ tattha tatth'eva sāni hareyyuṃ. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, alaṃ nu kho tassa purisassa aññathattāyā'ti?

50085.meaning1: name of a female deity; attendant of king Vessavaṇa
50085.meaning2: name of a female deity; attendant of king Vessavaṇa

examples.text: tena kho pana, bhante, samayena bhagavā aññatarena samādhinā nisinno hoti, bhuñjatī ca nāma vessavaṇassa mahārājassa paricārikā bhagavantaṃ paccupaṭṭhitā hoti, pañjalikā namassamānā tiṭṭhati.
āvuso, āgantuka kuṭumbikassa te gehe bhattaṃ bhuñjanato varataraṃ mīḷhaṃ khādituṃ… kuṭumbikena dinnasāṭakanivāsanato varataraṃ naggena vicarituṃ

50089.synonym: ajjhoharanta, āsaka, āhārayanta, paribhuñjanta, bhuñjamāna, bhogī

examples.text: sappāyāni c'eva bhojanāni bhuñjeyyāsi, mā te asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
ānaṇyasukhaṃ ñatvāna, atho atthisukhaṃ paraṃ, bhuñjaṃ bhogasukhaṃ macco, tato paññā vipassati.

50091.synonym: ajjhoharanta, āsaka, āhārayanta, paribhuñjanta, bhuñjanta, bhogī

examples.text: araññe viharantānaṃ, santānaṃ brahmacārinaṃ, ekabhattaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ, kena vaṇṇo pasīdatī'ti.

etha, tumhe'pi, bhikkhave, ek'āsanabhojanaṃ bhuñjatha. ek'āsanabhojanaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tumhe'pi bhuñjamānā app'ābādhatañ'ca sañjānissatha app'ātaṅkatañ'ca lah'uṭṭhānañ'ca balañ'ca phāsuvihārañ'cā'ti.

50092.commentary: (THIa) rattiṃ bhattaṃ na bhuñj'ahan'ti ratt'ūparatā hutvā rattiyaṃ bhojanaṃ na bhuñjiṃ.

examples.text: bahūvatasamādānā, aḍḍhaṃ sīsassa olikhiṃ, chamāya seyyaṃ kappemi, rattiṃ bhattaṃ na bhuñj'ahaṃ.

50095.meaning1: should be eaten; can be eaten; edible
50095.commentary: (VINa) sakiṃ bhuñjitabban'ti ekadivasaṃ bhuñjitabbaṃ, dutiyadivasato paṭṭhāya paṭiggahaṇe dukkaṭaṃ, ajjhohāre ajjhohāre pācittiyaṃ.

examples.text: agilānena bhikkhunā eko āvasathapiṇḍo bhuñjitabbo. tato ce uttari bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
idaṃ te khāditabbaṃ, idaṃ te na khāditabbaṃ, idaṃ te bhuñjitabbaṃ, idaṃ te na bhuñjitabbaṃ, idaṃ te sāyitabbaṃ, idaṃ te na sāyitabbaṃ, idaṃ te pātabbaṃ, idaṃ te na pātabbaṃ
asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi antaraghare bhuñjitā

50097.meaning1: desire to eat; wish to eat

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, gilānena bhikkhunā sūpam'pi odanam'pi attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjituṃ. evañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha

bhoto kho dāne evarūpaṃ bhojanaṃ dīyati kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ, yaṃ bhavaṃ pādā'pi na iccheyya samphusituṃ, kuto bhuñjituṃ, dhorakāni ca vatthāni guḷavālakāni, yāni bhavaṃ pādā'pi na iccheyya samphusituṃ, kuto paridahituṃ.

50099.meaning1: (of sensual pleasures) to use; to enjoy; to partake (of)

examples.text: sakkā bhoge ca bhuñjituṃ puññāni ca kātuṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattitvā bhoge ca bhuñjeyyaṃ puññāni ca kareyyan'ti.
